title: Clarinetists George Baquet, Leo Grillo and Rick Roland; Papa Laine's band
summary: Christian and Rose discuss clarinetists who played with him, including Baquet and the particular, respected Leo Grillo, and Rose suggests Christian played with Baquet in Papa Laine's band.
